M14.text: D90 has 55 ContextLimit exits and 35 Submitted exits. Its 1,883 model calls produced 1,822 bash actions and 61 submit_patch actions, with zero graph or source-reference requests at raw, parsed, executed, visible and consumed stages. The exact native tool-call parsing diagnostic found zero parsing failures, separately from 26 source-bound early-return observations for invalid submit attempts. This does not imply that every action or candidate was valid. All 18 task/seed initial comparisons verified identical messages across C0–C4 and identical graph-tool schemas across C1–C4; C0 differs in graph-tool availability. Consequently, D90 did not exercise the intended graph-answer guidance or conditional fallback. This cannot show that warnings are ineffective or that graph execution would have failed. [E1, E5]

M25.text: Graph-query schemas were available in 144/180 episodes and source-reference search in all 180, but neither tool was requested or executed. Authenticated native counts contain no malformed tool shapes, unknown names or parser failures. Source review found matching schemas, parser names and handlers; tool choice remained optional. C2/C3 warnings occur in graph responses, and C4 verification runs conditionally inside graph_query, so these mechanisms never activated. This establishes offered-but-unused tools, not functioning dormant backends or why the model chose bash. Bash activity does not establish semantic verification. [E30, E31]

qualitative_statements.fragment: Source review found matching schemas, parser names and handlers; tool choice remained optional.
qualitative_statements.source_text: The common prompt requires a tool call, not either graph/source-reference tool. LocalModel sends the exact schemas with tool_choice=auto. Schema names, registered handlers and the parser allowlist agree; parsed action arguments are dispatched to the matching methods.

qualitative_statements.fragment: C2/C3 warnings occur in graph responses, and C4 verification runs conditionally inside graph_query
qualitative_statements.source_text: C2 generic and C3 nonexhaustiveness guidance is inserted only into graph responses. C4 source verification is inside graph_query and additionally requires error/truncation/unindexed/sparse incoming evidence plus budget. With zero graph queries none of these response-triggered mechanisms could execute or deliver a warning/verification result.

qualitative_statements.fragment: This establishes offered-but-unused tools, not functioning dormant backends or why the model chose bash.
qualitative_statements.source_text: The records establish offered-but-unused API tool schemas and coherent exercised bash/submit plumbing, not successful execution of dormant graph handlers or proof that the model understood them. Server-normalized response.tool_calls counts do not independently decode the token stream or establish the cause of tool choice.
